cues.en: Mike Cohen: Violin plots are one of the most beautiful ways of illustrating a distribution of data.
cues.zh: Mike Cohen：小提琴圖是呈現資料分布最美觀的方法之一。

cues.en: So let's see what a violin plot is and how to create it.
cues.zh: 我們來看看什麼是小提琴圖，以及如何繪製。

cues.en: So a violin plot is essentially made from taking a histogram, spinning it on its side, reflecting it, and smoothing it.
cues.zh: 小提琴圖基本上就是把直方圖轉向側邊，再鏡射並平滑化。

cues.en: And that's basically all there is to it.
cues.zh: 基本上就是這麼回事。

cues.en: So we start off with a histogram, looks something like this for this particular dataset, the next step is to rotate this.
cues.zh: 我們先從直方圖開始，這組資料的圖形大致像這樣，下一步是旋轉它。

cues.en: So now what's the x axis here is now the Y axis.
cues.zh: 原本這裡的 X 軸，現在變成 Y 軸。

cues.en: So now we have counts or probability or proportion or whatever on the x axis and the data value on the Y axis.
cues.zh: 現在 X 軸表示次數、機率、比例之類的數值，Y 軸表示資料值。

cues.en: And then the next step is to take this thing and just flip it horizontally.
cues.zh: 下一步就是把這個圖形水平翻轉。

cues.en: So we mirror it. It's like putting a mirror over here.
cues.zh: 也就是鏡射，像在這裡放一面鏡子。

cues.en: And that's really all there is to creating a violin plot.
cues.zh: 建立小提琴圖基本上就是如此。

cues.en: A violin plot proper is smooth.
cues.zh: 正式的小提琴圖會是平滑的。

cues.en: So it takes this histogram and will smooth it out a little bit, interpolate it to make it look smoother, and sometimes you'll also see some additional lines drawn on
cues.zh: 所以會把這個直方圖稍微平滑化，透過內插讓外觀更平滑，有時還會畫上一些額外的線，

cues.en: like the mean and the median, but this is the basic idea.
cues.zh: 例如平均值和中位數，但基本概念就是這樣。

cues.en: All right, so here we see another example.
cues.zh: 好，這裡是另一個範例。

cues.en: This is a histogram of data.
cues.zh: 這是資料的直方圖。

cues.en: You can see there's a lot of data clustered down here.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，下方聚集了很多資料。

cues.en: It looks a bit like a log normal distribution, except that there's another cluster of data around here, around five.
cues.zh: 它有點像對數常態分布，只是在這裡、約為 5 的地方，又有另一群資料。

cues.en: So we might call this a bimodal distribution.
cues.zh: 所以我們可以稱它為雙峰分布。

cues.en: Okay, so again, we take this thing, we rotate it, and then we mirror it on its side and smooth it out and this is the resulting violin plot.
cues.zh: 好，同樣地，我們把它旋轉，再向側邊鏡射並平滑化，得到這張小提琴圖。

cues.en: So this is the violin plot that comes from the data in this histogram.
cues.zh: 這張小提琴圖就來自這個直方圖中的資料。

cues.en: So here's the distribution, and then also sometimes shown in violin plots would be the inner quartile range like this so you can see where 50% of the data lies.
cues.zh: 這裡是分布，而小提琴圖有時也會像這樣顯示四分位距，讓你看到 50% 的資料位於何處。

cues.en: So this would be quartile one and quartile three.
cues.zh: 這裡分別是第一四分位數和第三四分位數。

cues.en: Here we see the median in green, and here you also see the mean in red.
cues.zh: 這裡以綠色表示中位數，這裡則以紅色表示平均值。

cues.en: So this also nicely illustrates that there is some distribution skew.
cues.zh: 這也很清楚地呈現出分布具有偏斜。

cues.en: Now the skew is, which moment was that?
cues.zh: 偏斜是由第幾動差描述的呢？

cues.en: Which statistical moment describes the skew of a distribution?
cues.zh: 哪一個統計動差用來描述分布的偏斜？

cues.en: I'm sure you guessed it, it was the third statistical moment, that is the skew.
cues.zh: 我相信你猜到了，就是第三統計動差，也就是偏度。

cues.en: So you can see that the data are skewed, well partly just by looking at it, but also because the mean and the median are different from each other.
cues.zh: 所以你可以看出資料有偏斜，一方面從外觀就能看出，另一方面也可以從平均值和中位數不同得知。

cues.en: This is a symmetric violin plot, so it shows exactly the same profile on the left and on the right.
cues.zh: 這是對稱的小提琴圖，因此左右兩側的輪廓完全相同。

cues.en: And you'll also, occasionally, you don't see this too often, but it can work sometimes, sometimes you'll see asymmetric distributions where, for example, if you have two different distributions
cues.zh: 偶爾也會看到不對稱的分布，雖然不常見，但有時很適合。例如你有兩個彼此相關的不同分布，

cues.en: that are related to each other, maybe these are two different conditions from an experiment, then you might show the distribution of condition A on the left and condition B on the right.
cues.zh: 可能是實驗中的兩種不同條件，就可以把條件 A 的分布畫在左側，條件 B 的分布畫在右側。

cues.en: So in that case, the distributions or the two sides might look a little bit different.
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，兩個分布，也就是兩側的形狀，可能會稍有不同。

cues.en: But it's pretty common to have a symmetric violin plot like this.
cues.zh: 不過，像這樣對稱的小提琴圖相當常見。

cues.en: So in this video I introduced you to violin plots.
cues.zh: 這部影片介紹了小提琴圖。

cues.en: They're a really nice, aesthetically appealing way to illustrate the distribution of a data set.
cues.zh: 這是一種很棒、視覺上也很美觀的資料集分布呈現方式。
